    "(Tutorial_OpenMM_H5MSMReporter)=\n",
    "# H5MSMReporter\n",
    "\n",
    "*Streaming OpenMM simulation trajectories directly to binary H5MSM files on disk.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The `H5MSMReporter` class writes high-speed compressed HDF5 binary trajectory files (`.h5msm`) incrementally during OpenMM molecular dynamics simulations.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects: {class}`molsysmt.third_party.openmm.reporters.H5MSMReporter`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "046773ef",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's stream trajectory data to an H5MSM file:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "78b98de0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:39:44.257868Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:39:44.257473Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:39:51.675234Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:39:51.673826Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "H5MSM trajectory written. Exists on disk: True\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import os\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "simulation = msm.convert(molsys, to_form='openmm.Simulation', temperature='300 K')\n",
    "\n",
    "h5_out = 'traj_run.h5msm'\n",
    "reporter = msm.third_party.openmm.reporters.H5MSMReporter(file=h5_out, reportInterval=10, steps=20)\n",
    "simulation.reporters.append(reporter)\n",
    "simulation.step(20)\n",
    "reporter.close()\n",
    "\n",
    "print('H5MSM trajectory written. Exists on disk:', os.path.exists(h5_out))\n",
    "if os.path.exists(h5_out):\n",
    "    os.remove(h5_out)"
   ]
  },
